name: Tadaima Shugyouchuu!
source:
Fantasy world filled with magic. Main character shares griefs and joys with village girls and aims to become a real wizard.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-july-2001-cosmos-no-sora-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一个充满魔法的幻想世界。主人公与村里的女孩们同甘共苦，立志成为一名真正的魔法师。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-july-2001-cosmos-no-sora-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
